items.title: Blue Faceted Ice Crystals
items.alt: Three tall blue crystalline ice shards rise above a low cluster of smaller angular chips.
items.description: Three tall blue crystalline ice shards rise above a low cluster of smaller angular chips. Use this illustration for winter fantasy collages.

items.title: Snowy Branch with Icicles
items.alt: A crooked bare branch carries a thick layer of snow and several long blue icicles.

items.alt: A tall black street lamp glows warmly beneath a snow cap, with a small evergreen sprig at its base.
items.description: A tall black street lamp glows warmly beneath a snow cap, with a small evergreen sprig at its base. Use this illustration for personal winter stationery.
